policy.mechanism: Retain latest PCM; gate startup/catch-up; atomically discard oldest queued prefix; no source-clock feedback

measurement_control.changes: Presentation begin/service are no-ops; original four-period silent priming and first-block start/unbounded append remain. All source events, observer hooks, renderer and game objects are identical.

source_event_equality.scope: Ordered game_ns/kind/channel/object of instrumented OPL key-ons and sample setup; all 1089 equal, independent of presentation drops

limitations: Queue-head observation brackets, not acoustic or hardware end-to-end latency; no ear test.
Deliberate native move blocks source production for about one second; starvation is recorded, not concealed.
Two one-block overflows outside forced stalls occurred in the loaded 95 s run; quiet 120 s run has none after startup.
38 music onset markers are explicitly discarded during corrections/catch-up; all source events and FM state still execute.
CPU is bounded Windows process sampling, not a distribution or a claim of exact unchanged CPU usage.
